LanguageData.BTG_AdoptBlockedByGuardians: Their people are still protecting them.
LanguageData.BTG_ForceClaim_Desc: Claim this building even while enemies remain on the map. Normally nothing can be claimed until every enemy is gone.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_EnableCargoVaultDesc:
When enabled, each settlement's cargo vault hatch can be hacked to access trade inventory.
When disabled, cargo vaults spawn sealed and inaccessible.
Only affects newly generated settlements, and requires the custom settlement map generator.
The smuggler's den vault is controlled by its quest reward instead of this setting.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_CargoVaultMaxStacksDesc: The maximum number of item stacks a cargo vault will contain when it is hacked open. The rest will stay in the settlement's trade inventory.\nLower this if a modded trader's vault slows or crashes the game. Slide fully right for no limit.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_CargoVaultMaxWealthDesc: The maximum market value of the items a cargo vault will contain when it is hacked open. The rest will stay in the settlement's trade inventory.\nSlide fully right for no limit.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TraderRotationDesc1: How often orbital traders rotate at Traders Guild settlements.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TraderRotationDesc2: Lower values will give more variety, but less time to reach distant settlements.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_UseCustomLayoutsDesc: When enabled, Traders Guild settlements will generate with furnished, lived-in interiors. When disabled, they will use the vanilla layouts, or allow other mods' map generation to run.\nThe smuggler's den always uses its own map generator.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_UseCustomLayoutsVGE2Note: Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 2 is active: its Traders Guild station is generated instead, with some of this mod's additions layered on top.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_DefendersVGE2Note: Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 2 is active: the settings below currently only affect the smuggler's den. Its Traders Guild stations keep vanilla garrisons and defeat rules for now.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SentryDroneDesc: Adjust the number of extra sentry drones on patrol. The number also grows with your colony's threat level.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SpacerTierDefendersDesc: When enabled, Traders Guild defenders will carry spacer-tech weapons, armor and implants of better quality, and garrisons will include more elite fighters. When disabled, they will use vanilla equipment and the vanilla garrison mix.\nCitizens and children will have vacuum protection either way.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_EntrenchedDefendersDesc: When enabled, defenders will stay inside their base to eat and rest, and will never assault or chase intruders into vacuum. When disabled, they will defend the base and then assault, as in vanilla.\nSettlement garrisons need the custom settlement map generator for this. The smuggler's den garrison does not.\nThis is decided when a map is generated, so it will only affect maps you enter afterwards.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ScaleDefenders: Scale defenders to colony threat level
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ScaleDefendersDesc: When enabled, a settlement's starting garrison will grow with your colony's wealth and the difficulty, like raids do. It will never be weaker than the vanilla garrison. When disabled, every settlement will have a similar garrison no matter how far you have progressed.\nThe smuggler's den garrison is sized by its quest instead.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ThreatMultiplierDesc: Higher values will give settlements more and stronger defenders when you first enter them.\nThe smuggler's den garrison is sized by its quest instead.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SecurityDefeatThresholdDesc: The share of the original defenders that must be downed before the faction gives up a settlement or the smuggler's den.\nGuards and patrolling sentry drones count. Turrets and worker mechs do not.\nAt 100% they will fight to the last defender.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_LifeSupportDesc: The power produced by each life support unit.\nThis changes every life support unit, so it will affect all orbital platforms, not only Traders Guild settlements.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_TradeRequestQuestWeightDesc: How often the storyteller offers the guild's shuttle trade request quest, weighed against every other quest it could pick.\nSet to 0 to stop the quest being offered at all.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_SmugglersDenQuestWeightDesc: How often the storyteller offers the smuggler's den quest, weighed against every other quest it could pick.\nSet to 0 to stop the quest being offered at all.
LanguageData.BTG_ResupplyDropArrived: The garrison's distress call has drawn a response.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ResupplyMealsPerDefenderDes: The number of packaged survival meals delivered for each surviving defender when a starving garrison calls for resupply. Defenders will use a comms console to make the call once the food inside their base has run out.\nSet to 0 to disable resupply calls. Only one drop can land on a map every 6 hours.\nRequires entrenched defender AI.
LanguageData.BTG_Settings_ResupplyTriggersRaidDesc: When enabled, a successful resupply call will also bring a drop pod raid from the garrison's faction to hunt your colonists. The raiders will attack freely instead of holding the base, and will sometimes land right on top of your colonists in a smaller group. This will only happen while the faction is hostile.
LanguageData.BTG_CargoVaultHatch_RelockDesc: Relock the cargo vault. Its contents will be returned to the settlement's trade inventory.
LanguageData.BTG_EmpireRelationFix_DialogBody:
A bug in a previous version of {2} caused {0} to be permanently hostile when playing as {1}.

This has been corrected.

Would you like to reset your relations with {0} to neutral, or remain hostile for now?
LanguageData.BTG_GameStartDialog_ExiledTraders:
Your guild transponder is dead, and the mechhive tracks your signal. Its terrifying murder machines will arrive soon. Gather the valuable gravlite panels, then use your gravship to flee to a safe location on the planet below.

To launch the gravship, select the pilot console, then select the launch command.

On the world map, select 'view planet' to choose a landing spot on the planet.

The Guild won't help you, and wherever you go, the mechanoids will eventually find you. To stop them, you must find and defeat the mechhive itself.
LanguageData.BTG_GameStartDialog_IndependentTraders: The Traders Guild is behind you now, along with the split margins and the crowded docking bays. There are no hard feelings. You just have bigger plans.\n\nYour shuttle is burning toward the unclaimed wilds, and silver alone won't keep you alive out here. The Guild will still deal with old friends, but first you need a home.
